name: Atlas Stone Over Bar
description: The classic strongman atlas stone event where competitors load a heavy spherical stone over a tall bar or onto a platform. The stone must be lapped (rested on the thighs), then elevated over the target height. This tests raw pulling, pushing, and grip strength in a unique athletic pattern.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Atlas Stone Over Bar in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Atlas Stone Over Bar.
steps: Step 1: Stand over stone with feet wide. Reach down and grip sides of stone.
Step 2: Pull stone up to lap position resting on thighs.
Step 3: Adjust grip higher on stone and drive hips forward explosively.
Step 4: Continue driving stone up and over the bar or platform target.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Pulling with arms instead of legs
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Lap the stone first, then elevate
